stages.caption: 4 identity spans tokenized. Amounts, dates and the pattern stay intact.

stages.title: Train
stages.in: amount=$83,472 · 9 sub-threshold deposits · counterparty graph · temporal window
stages.out: Risk score from graph-walk + temporal features; identity fields are tokens and contribute nothing.
stages.caption: The model trains on the protected ledger: identity is a token, the signal is behaviour.

stages.title: Retrieve
stages.in: behavioural: 'structuring, sub-threshold cash deposits'   |   identity: 'find records for this person'
stages.out: A behavioural query still finds the record (the pattern lives in the tokens). An identity query collapses (a token has no link to the name).
stages.caption: Retrieval survives or dies by what the query asks for.

stages.title: Infer
stages.in_label: Prompt the model actually received (tokens only)

stages.out: Summarises the case citing the token subject and the deposit pattern; never emits a real identifier, because it never saw one.
stages.caption: The language model reasons entirely over pseudonymous tokens.

stages.title: Egress
stages.out: Scanned before a human sees it. A real identifier that slipped through is blocked; a reply written only over protection tokens is released, because a token carries no real identity.
stages.caption: Every response is scanned at the boundary.

stages.title: Present
stages.out: Auditor: nothing · Analyst: structure only · Investigator: full re-identification (the entitled role).
stages.caption: Plaintext only for the role entitled to it: the single presentation boundary.
